## RESEARCH VERDICT

Verdict: caution  
Risk: high  
Confidence: 0.58  
Rationale: FY26 filings support cash and balance-sheet screens, but lithium price cyclicality, FY25 thin post-capex cash, and unverified Yahoo TTM FCF leave the quantitative buy only partly filing-aligned.  
RiskTags: cyclical, leverage, competitive, customer_concentration

`adjusted_signal` remains **buy** (same as raw); open overlays after review include suppressed/unverified TTM cashflow, Piotroski operating-cash failures, and dividend-family model fails despite a resumed FY26 payout.

---

## COMPARISON EVIDENCE

### EVIDENCE

- [filings/bodies/b830a4c9aebe5908.txt] "Cash margin from operations $M 1,357 192 608" — FY26 operating cash generation far above FY25, aligning directionally with screen FCF-yield inputs (Yahoo FY26 annual, not filing TTM).
- [filings/bodies/928ce56ce0b52368.txt] "Cash margin from operations less mine development costs and sustaining capex was $28M." — FY25 trough cash after sustaining spend; screens keyed to recovery year risk overstating through-cycle FCF.
- [filings/bodies/928ce56ce0b52368.txt] "The Board of PLS did not declare a final dividend payment for FY25 in line with the Company’s Capital Management Framework" — No FY25 dividend; dividend-yield screen rests on a single FY26 5c final, not a sustained payout record.
- [filings/bodies/c664bba741782680.txt] "No interim dividend has been declared, consistent with the Company’s capital management framework" — H1 FY26 interim cut/absence; tension with dividend-oriented model passes at low headline yield (1.8%).
- [filings/bodies/b830a4c9aebe5908.txt] "Final dividend of 5  cents per share (fully franked) determined, representing a ~$161M distribution to shareholders" — Resumed payout with stated ~22% of FY26 adjusted free cash flow (board framing).
- [filings/bodies/c09f130d76138950.txt] "Realised price US$/t 1,8091 2,1072 (14)" — Sep Q FY27 realised price down 14% qoq; cyclical earnings/FCF sensitivity versus screen metrics anchored to stronger FY26.
- [filings/bodies/c09f130d76138950.txt] "Post September Quarter end, PLS successfully closed its US$700M 8.00% Senior Unsecured Notes due 20321." — Additional debt ahead of P2000 capex; leverage overlay relevant to risk family pass.

### NUMBERS

- Cash margin from operations | $1,357M | FY26 | [filings/bodies/b830a4c9aebe5908.txt]
- Capex | $328M | FY26 | [filings/bodies/b830a4c9aebe5908.txt]
- Cash margin from operations less mine development and sustaining capex | $28M | FY25 | [filings/bodies/928ce56ce0b52368.txt]
- Statutory (loss)/profit after tax | $(196)M | FY25 | [filings/bodies/928ce56ce0b52368.txt]
- Net profit/(loss) after tax | $526M | FY26 | [filings/bodies/b830a4c9aebe5908.txt]
- Free Cash Flow (Yahoo fallback) | 1020354000.0 | annual 2026 in `financials_annual.json` | [financials_annual.json]

### THESIS BREAKS

- FY27 average realised spodumene price sustained materially below unit operating cost (CIF/FOB) disclosed in successive quarters, driving negative underlying EBITDA as in FY25.
- Liquidity falls meaningfully below committed P2000/growth capex and debt service without an equity raise (cash plus undrawn facilities no longer covering stated investment pipeline).
- Material downward revision to Pilgangoora Ore Reserves or P2000 production schedule in a subsequent ASX reserve/resource or guidance update.
- Statutory operating cash flow consistently below net profit over multiple reporting periods (reinstating screen Piotroski “OCF > earnings” failures on a filing basis).
